interpretation: Both images make exactly 53,253,960 Node reads and 8,740,226 stored appends on this source corpus.
G28 additionally decodes 223,267,270 fields and encodes 32,575,505 fields. Two extra encodes are the source/transient default TermQuant seeds, not appends.
R12 returns an existing Node; its codec counters are zero. These are logical operations and selected field counts, NOT physical allocations or byte totals.
Diagnostic instrumentation adds calls and branches; all counter-run times and memory are ineligible for performance acceptance.
Read tag histograms match exactly; append histograms match after separating the two G28 default row encodes.
